messages:
Asha: Short postmortem follow-up from the midnight GPU surge. Capturing owners + minimal checklist so we can close loop quickly.
Ben: Please list the exact remediation items and who owns them.
Asha: Action list: 1) Scheduler: reduce preempt threshold + update binpack weights (owner: Ben) 2) Autoscaler: headroom->15%, scaleDown grace->30s (owner: Kira) 3) Quota: request provisional +20% GPUs for 48h (owner: Samir) 4) Runbook: paste-ready commands + escalation contacts (owner: Asha) 5) Metrics: add surge-rate per-hour chart and weekly recurrence alert (owner: ops).
Kira: I'll run a canary of autoscaler change in staging and post perf. ETA: 24h.
Ben: I'll prototype scheduler tweak and add a pre-merge perf gate. ETA: 48h.
Samir: Opening CAP ticket now and will ask billing for provisional window. Tagging cloud-team.
ops-bot: Task created: CAP-6732 (provisional GPU quota). Linked to INC-4099.
Asha: Runbook snippet for PR:
```
# temp scale up batchers
kubectl scale deploy gpu-batch -n inference --replicas=35
# patch autoscaler
kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"minHeadroom":"0.15","scaleDownGrace":"30s"}}'
# quick queue check
kubectl get pods -n inference -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}' | xargs -n1 kubectl top pod -n inference
```
Kira: Staging shows fewer preemptions so far (~11% drop). Uploading graphs to dashboard.
Samir: CAP-6732 submitted: https://infra.company/tickets/CAP-6732. Waiting billing signoff.
Asha: Owners recap: Ben (scheduler), Kira (autoscaler), Samir (quota), Asha (runbook). Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to review results; weekly check-ins for two weeks after closure. Closure criteria: quota approved OR surges reduced >=50% over 2 weeks.
Ben: Adding tasks to sprint board and will link PR when ready.
Asha: Thanks everyone — ping here for handoffs or if you need a backup.
